findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed two spills on the floor in the stock room, one along the walking path and one near the delivery door. These spills need to be cleaned up to prevent employees from stepping in them and tracking the sticky substances throughout the facility. Ensure the spills are cleaned and that the facility is cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain it clean.
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
4-501.11: The ice machine located furthest from the entrance of the facility along the exterior of the building was observed to have the fan dripping onto the bags of ice creating an excessive amount of ice buildup. Ensure proper maintenance is performed on this equipment to maintain the integrity of the machine and the ice that is held within the machine.
 4-501.11: (A) EQUIPMENT shall be maintained in good repair. (B) EQUIPMENT components shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted to manufacturer’s specifications.
